notes: Kiosk mode for the school tablet: with the app as device owner, Piano › Kiosk makes the app the home screen and switches off Home, Recents, the shade and the lock screen; the tablet comes straight back into the app after a reboot. Hold the byline for three seconds and enter the PIN to unlock for a while or turn kiosk off. In kiosk, settings, disconnecting, imports and deletions ask for the PIN; playing, queueing and browsing stay free. Left alone, the tablet rests in display mode.
